NARRATIVE AND PLANS

Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
DC-16, Downtown Core District to DC-16, Downtown Core District

170 West Washington Street, Chicago, IHinois 60602
P.LN. 17-09-446-009-0000
Applicant: CONTRA, LLC

The Property

The subject property is located at 170 West Washington Street in the City of Chicago, Cook
County, Illinois (P.I.N. 17-09-446-009), and is improved with an existing four-story masonry
commercial building with basement, of Type III-A construction. The building contains a total gross
floor area of approximately 15,300 square feet and an existing height of approximately 58 feet.
The property has approximately 40.50 feet of frontage on the north line of West Washington Street
and an approximate depth of 120 feet, comprising approximately 4,540.11 square feet of land
(0.1042 acres, more or less), as shown on the ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey prepared by Zarko
Sekerez & Associates, Inc., dated May 31, 2026, a copy of which is filed with the application.

The property is bounded on the south by West Washington Street (an 80-foot-wide public right-
of-way), on the north by a public alley of varying width, and on the east and west by adjacent
commercial buildings. The existing building contains mixed M-Mercantile and B-Business
occupancies. The property is located within the West Loop-LaSalle Street Historic District but is
not individually designated as a Chicago Landmark. The property is not within the Lakefront
Protection District, is not within any zoning overlay district, is not located on a designated
Pedestrian Street, and is located more than 500 feet from any school as required under Section 17-
9-0129(3) of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance. The property is not located within any boundary in
which Adult Use Cannabis Dispensaries are excluded under Section 17-7-0560.

The Project

The Applicant, CONTRA, LLC, seeks a Type 1 zoning map amendment under Sections 17-9-
0129(1) and 17-13-0302 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance to permit the operation of an Adult Use
Cannabis Dispensary (Zoning Use Category AAA-1, per Section 17-4-0301) within an
approximately 2,900-square-foot tenant suite on the first floor of the existing building. The
dispensary will occupy a portion of the ground floor only; the balance of the building's
approximately 15,300 square feet of floor area will continue to be used for the existing M-
Mercantile and B-Business uses, which are unrelated to the proposed dispensary.

No exterior modifications to the building are proposed. No changes to the building's existing means
of ingress and egress are proposed. No parking exists or will be provided, and none is required for
the proposed use under Section 17-10-0208. No off-street loading or bicycle parking is required

or proposed under Sections 17-10-0207 et seq. The existing bulk, density, height, and floor area
of the building will remain unchanged. Exterior signage will be reviewed under a separate permit
application, as will fire alarm and sprinkler work.

Although the Type 1 amendment results in the same DC-16, Downtown Core District designation,
it is required by Section 17-9-0129(1) of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance to permit the
establishment of an Adult Use Cannabis Dispensary at this location. A community meeting will
be held within the ward in advance of the City Council hearing in compliance with Section 17-9-

0129(7).

Operational and Design Characteristics

The dispensary will be designed and operated consistent with applicable State of Illinois cannabis
regulations and the requirements of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance for Adult Use Cannabis
Dispensaries, including the following measures depicted on the attached plans:

* Patron access is controlled through a secured vestibule and electronic access control
system; on-site personnel verify patron identification prior to admission to the retail area.

¢ All cannabis and other regulated products are securely stored within a dedicated vault
constructed in accordance with the security wall assembly specified in the plans, which is
designed to resist a minimum of thirty (30) man-minutes against surreptitious entry, ten
(10) man-minutes against forced entry, and twenty (20) man-hours against lock
manipulation and radiological techniques.

* Nocannabis products will be displayed in the retail area; all products on display are dummy
packaging or non-regulated items only.

* Direct view into the retail area from the public way is prohibited, and direct view from the
retail area into the vault is prohibited; all exterior glazing is treated with translucent, film.

* Video surveillance cameras are installed throughout the interior of the facility and at the
exterior side of each exterior door; all security and surveillance equipment is connected to
self-contained battery backup power that maintains function during a power outage.

* Cannabis waste is stored within the tenant suite until destruction under compliance with
IDFPR requirements; non-cannabis waste utilizes the existing common-tenant dumpsters
located on the property.

* The existing mechanical system serving the tenant suite will be upgraded to mitigate odors
at the exterior of the building.

* On-site consumption of cannabis products is prohibited.

*  State-required cannabis signage will be installed in conspicuous public-facing locations,
including notices regarding minimum patron age, twenty-four-hour surveillance,

prohibition of interstate transportation, hours of operation, business license information,
restricted-area designations, and maximum occupancy limits.
